svg.title: Centroid predictions by quarter
svg.desc: Twelve separate quarter rows compare measured column and row shifts, with one-sigma errors, to target and neighbour predictions. Filled circles are measurements, open circles target predictions, squares neighbour predictions. Column and row axes use different labelled scales.
